metadata.case_name: WONG SHIU PING v. SECRETARY FOR JUSTICE FOR AND ON BEHALF OF THE DIRECTOR OF LEISURE AND CULTURAL SERVICE

plaintiff.occupation_before: Previously worked as a cook and a hawker; retired at 65
plaintiff.occupation_after: Retired; sometimes worked as a casual worker doing odd jobs

source: he sustained a 10 cm laceration wound on his forehead.
The plaintiff sustained a 10 cm laceration over his forehead and also injuries to his left shoulder. The wound over his head was closed by suturing with 9 stitches.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

source: diagnosis of head concussion following the Accident.
In the joint medical report of Dr Fu Wai Kee and Dr Poon Kai Ming, both experts agree with the diagnosis of head concussion following the Accident.

injuries.description: Minor soft tissue injury of the left shoulder
source: minor soft tissue injury of the left shoulder as a result of the accident.

Both experts however agree that the plaintiff has sustained minor soft tissue injury of the left shoulder as a result of the accident. It is agreed that the plaintiff has recovered fully from the left shoulder injury.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: Mild scalp soft tissue swelling at the right frontal aspect (CT scan)
source: CT scan of the brain was done which revealed mild scalp soft tissue swelling at the right frontal aspect.

pins and needles sensations over his body
